faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Do I need a nutritionist to use the app?
faq.a1: No. You can use it self-managed and add professional support whenever you want.
faq.q2: Can I try it before creating an account?
faq.a2: Yes. The demo and tour let you explore without signing up.
faq.a3: We follow standard security practices and session isolation. Avoid sharing credentials and sign out on public devices.
